responsibility: Defines the C enums and accessor macros representing C-SKY processors, base architectures, FPU kinds, and floating-point ABI choices after GCC option parsing. It materializes the core, arch, and FPU catalogs from csky_cores.def into backend-visible enum values such as TARGET_CPU_* and TARGET_FPU_*, giving the rest of the port a compact typed interface for option-selected target configuration.
